_comment: Example of the claims section of a FORGED Cognito JWT. All real IDs are placeholders - fill them from your own token before testing.
_description: The forger script (exploit.py) takes the attacker's own valid JWT and swaps username/cognito:username (and optionally sub) with the victim's values while keeping the original signature. The backend decodes-but-does-not-verify, so it accepts the forgery.
